generalCriterionList.description: 1)Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable. (2) Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory. (3) It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

4)The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders.The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.(5) EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.(6) Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025 percent of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- and Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

7)Recent and relevant Certificates and details shall be furnished & Contractor Conditional tenders are not accepted. (8)Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate 50% of the amount put to tender in single work & of similar nature of work from the competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the original certificated and attach the scanned file to the tender. The original certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Tenders. (Last 5 financial years) (9) Third party consultants may be engaged for checking quality and quantity of work and to prevent any misuse. Proper reporting methods, through these agencies and their comments to be reviewed / addressed immediately at District level. Quality of work is of most importance.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

10)If any dates mentioned above happens to be a holiday, the next working day and the same time and venue holds good in lieu of the date mentioned. (11) The contractor should scan the work done certificate, TIN number, PAN and Registration certificates and other documents. If not scanned above certificates such tenders will be rejected. (12) As per Karnatka State Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare Fund. & Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders.

13)The authority competent to accept the tenders shall have the right of rejecting all or any of tenders without assigning any reasons and will not be bound to accept the lowest tenders. (14) Materials like pipe, CI pipe, cement aggregate sand etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and shall be of standered quality as per IS specifications and should get tested by the quality control authority before used to the work at his own cost. (15) The work will be placed under third party inspection.
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

16)The lowest bidder will furnish security deposit & Below amount before the work order is given or 20 days from the date of acceptance whichever is earlier(DD/FDR). (17) The contractor should have yearly turnover not less than the Amount put to Tender in any two financial years out of last 5 financial years. i.e. 2021-22 , 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (Turn over Certificate) (Certified by Chartered Accountant) (With UDIN No) (18) The contractor should upload the Line of Credit for value not less than 30% of the Amount put to Tender.

19)Each Tenderer shall own or make arrangements for procuring the machineries required for executing the work & all the materials should be brought and used by the contractors and materials will not be supplied from the Department. (20) The work should be carried out in accordance with the standard specifications specified by the department. Maintenance period from the contractor for the above works is 1 year from the date of completion of work.

21)The work should be executed strictly as per the tender specification mentioned. Contractor should arrange for quality check at different stage of work for quality assurance as per direction of Engineer-in-charge during the work in progress and after completion. If any failures found the cost will be recovered from the contractor and will be recommended for black listing immediately. (22) All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

23)Contractor should made an agreement within 90 days of tender acceptance date and work should be carried out with in the 1 week time after agreement. If not tender will be cancelled at the contractors own risk and cost. (24) The contractor must scan the Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B ) (25) Any over writing of civil engineering words and measurements should be clarified the considered department ( No claims should be considered) (26) Acceptence / Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.

27)Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.More details should be collected from the office at working hours. (28) The contractor who bid under reservation works (SC&ST) should submitte the cast retificate & residentional proof ( atleast for 10 years in Karnatak) as per the rules of Govt of Karnataka No: FD 876 Exp-12/2017, Bengaluru, Dated : 15-09-2017

29)Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT:For the clause-29.1 follow the Government order RDW&SD 18 RWS (5) 2019 Bangalore Dated 27.02.2019. & FD 456 Exp-12/2022, Bengalore, Dated 10-08-2022 (30) The Bidder should Quote the rate with out GST.(31) All the items of work mentioned in Schedule-B are inclusive of all lead and lifts, incidental charges etc., work should be carried out as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge.

32)Materials to be utiliszed for the work must be tested in RDWSD Quality lab and quality control test reports must be enclosed to the bills. Cost of quality control tests must be borne by the contractor

itemList.description: Ladder inside the container: Providing anodized aluminium ladder using 65mm x 32mm x 3.0mm ‘C’ section for ladder side channel x 25mm dia., flutal pipe for Rungs at 250mm c/c ladder fixed at an angle of 70 degrees to horizontal including necessary 25mm dia., G.I. shutters with necessary G.I. fasteners for bracing the ladders to the Tank walls to prevent buckling of the ladder with necessary  (M-15) bed for embedding the ladder bottom complete.with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing DI Resilient seated soft sealing SLUICE VALVE of variouis dia. with body bonnet of Ductile Iron (DI) conforming ti IS-1865 with the latest amendments and of grade GGG 40/50, shaft of stainless steel, wedge fully rubber lined with EDPM seals of NBR and the valves should be vacum tight and 100% leak proof with face to face dimensions as per IS 14846-2000 with the latest amendments only. The stem sealing should be with toroidal sealing rings (minimum 2 " O " rings). Body and bonnet should be coated with Electrostatically applied Epoxy Powder Coating with minimum coating thickness of 250 micron both inside and outside. The rate is inclusive of cost of valves, T.P set, galvanized bolts & nuts and rubber insertions etc. but excluding earth work. For PN-10: (Note: TP set should be considered only for DI pipes estimate. For MS pipes estimates, TP sets cost of corresponding dia shall be deducted from the SR rates of valves and provision for corresponding dia MS flanges should be made in the estimate.) 80 mm etc. complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Finishing walls with water proofing cement paint of required shade :Old work (one coats applied @ 2.20 kg/10 m²) over priming coat of primer applied @ 0.80 l/10 m² complete including cost of Priming coat including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning the surface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour completeas per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Lettering with black Japan paint of approved brand and manufacture to givean even shade including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning thesurface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labourcomplete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work. (per letter per cm height)

Providing  &  fixing  fly  proof  wire  gauze  to  windows,  clerestory windows  & doors with M.S. Flat 15x3 mm and nuts & bolts complete. Galvanised  M.S. Wire gauze with 0.63 mm dia wire and 1.4 mm aperture on both sides   including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete  as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and laying water proofing treatment to the Water tanks & Liq-uid Retaining structures with two component acrylic polymer modified cementitious waterproofing membrane with minimum elongation of 50% applied @ 1.5 kg/m2 for internal side waterproofing in two layers with waiting period of 4-6 hrs per layer and food grade epoxy coating in two coats certified by CFTRI Mysuru, including surface preparation completely as per specification with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing, Laying and Jointing Cast Iron (CI) double flanged pipes true to line / hoisting of DI flanged pipe in position and aligning to correct  plumb, including cost of jointing materials, conveying to work spot with  all lead and lifts etc. complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing RCC final and ventilators as per approved design and specifications with form works and protected with wire mesh.  The plinth to be of RCC circular pillars and canopy with an ornamental finish at top.  The first 22.5 cms height to be covered with RCC panelling as per detailed drawings etc. with all lead and lifts and excluding reinforcement steel :complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Dubbing out on old irregular walls average 10mm thick and making good the surface with cement mortar 1:3 including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per specifications complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and laying in position Reinforced cement concrete   for all Foundation   works. The   granite/trap/basalt   crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers  laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators,  including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of  relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery,  curing and all the other  appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement & formwork to be paid separately)with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing hand rail of approved size by welding etc. to steel ladder railing, balcony railing, staircase railing and similar works, including applying priming coat of approved steel primer. M.S. tube including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing MS inspection door of size 60 cms x 60 cms, including MS frame made of 50x50x6mm angle, shutters made of 3mm thick MS sheets, with hinges, locking arrangements at top etc. including painting with anticorrosive approved paint etc. complete including all lead and lifts etc with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Earth work excavation for pipelines/cables by Manual means upto 600 mm trench width, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or leveling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m. Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage& other appurtenances required to complete the work.in all kind of soils.Depth upto 1.5m with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing PVC ringtite pipes conforming to IS 4985:2000 with latest amendments and conveying to worksite, rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and level and perfect linking at joints, testing and commissioning, including loading unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointing  of PVC pipes and specials (excluding cost of specials) with jointing of approved type, with all labour with all lead & lift including encasing the pipe alround to a depth of not less than 15 cms. with soft gravel or selected  earth available from the excavation etc. complete and giving necessary hydraulic test to the required pressure as per ISS (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) etc. complete.  NOTE: Upto 110mm dia Coil shall be used.with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.
